Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 120. Category: heroic. Heroic Features.

You can throw aside all concern for Defense to Attack
with fierce desperation. When you make your first
Attack on Your Turn, you can decide to Attack
recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on all Melee
Attack rolls during this turn, but attack rolls against you
have advantage until your next turn.
